key_insight: A manufactured automated X-ray inspection platform combines modular pipe handling, servo positioning, and structural verification for pipe-weld inspection.
engineering_relevance: The system accommodates pipes 40–508 mm in diameter and 6–12 m long, with internal or external inspection depending on diameter and ±1 mm positioning accuracy.
method: Surveyed site layout and overhead-crane feeding requirements.
Designed a rail-guided carrier and height-adjustable X-ray positioning arm for imaging at 25 cm intervals.
Integrated servo positioning, laser verification, and an absolute encoder; assessed structures using finite element analysis.
evidence_signal: Reported peak stresses were 133.5 MPa for the arm and 211.1 MPa for the rail vehicle, with safety factors of 3.1 and 1.96; simulations were validated through tests on the manufactured system.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify defect-detection performance, inspection throughput, or radiation-shielding provisions.
paper_title: Design and Validation of an Automated X-Ray Imaging System for Pipe Weld Inspection
